messages.author: Sirpa Specialist
messages.text: Saw the note about bouncing the interface on TRN-051 after the SFP swap. On these old units I would replace the SFP first. The cage is usually the bad part on them, and a bounce just hides it for a while.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Not my experience. Check the counters, then disable and enable. The SFP was fine on both TRN-042 and TRN-051.

messages.author: Sirpa Specialist
messages.text: Those may be the lucky ones. I have seen old units come back with the same fault after a bounce.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: We should look at it properly next time one fails. I stand by what I said for now.
